state.goal: Ship offline support for a note-taking PWA: notes created offline must sync once the network returns.
done: Service worker caches the app shell; the app opens offline (e2e-verified).
Notes are stored in IndexedDB; create/edit works offline (unit-tested).
state.blocked: Conflict resolution needs a server-side revision field the backend does not expose yet (backend change pending review).
constraints: Every change must keep the existing e2e suite green.

decision.instructions: Choose the single best NEXT step toward the goal that does not depend on the pending backend change. Each option lists what it is plus pros AND cons — weigh the trade-off.

outbox_queue.what: Add an IndexedDB outbox that records offline writes and replays them in order when online (last-write-wins until revisions exist).
outbox_queue.pros: Makes offline writes reach the server at all — the core of the goal; testable today with the dead-server e2e pattern.
outbox_queue.cons: Last-write-wins can overwrite a concurrent edit until the revision field lands.

offline_indicator.what: Show an offline banner and per-note 'unsynced' badges.
offline_indicator.pros: Small, safe, user-visible; honest about sync state.
offline_indicator.cons: Cosmetic — no note reaches the server any sooner.

wait_for_backend.what: Pause offline work until the backend exposes revisions, then build sync with conflict resolution in one pass.
wait_for_backend.cons: Idle time; the outbox is needed either way and does not depend on revisions.
